messages.subject: For Ralph Mupita | Africa digital infrastructure, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear MTN Group Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Ralph Mupita, Group President and Chief Executive Officer.

MTN's growth across Africa increasingly spans AI-ready infrastructure, fintech, connectivity and digital inclusion, all of which require disciplined government, regulatory and stakeholder alignment. That interface closely matches my current work.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, regional strategy and emerging-market execution might support MTN's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to MTN Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
